description: Comptages routiers Sicoval is a dataset listed in OpenData Sicoval open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Sicoval - communauté d'agglomération du Sud-Est toulousain. Comptages routiers effectués sur la voirie communale sur demande des communes du sicoval. Données récupérées au travers de boitiers déposés par le service voirie Sicoval. Coverage: Sicoval (south-east Toulouse). The portal files it under Transport, Mobilité. Its keywords are comptage, voirie, Route, routier, voiture, poids lourds. The portal shows 162 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-28 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-sicoval-fr-portal.
